messages:
anya: quick heads up — starting onboarding for compact-embed-v2 (d=384) on the news-100k holdout. ran our usual sim/k-recall pipeline, and the int8 per-channel pass is showing a notable drop in recall@10 compared to fp32 :thinking:

sasha: can you paste config + the eval script you used? also which quant backend (onnx/qnnpack/fbgemm)? :eyes:

anya: ran with default quantize flow (onnx -> qlinear per-channel, symmetric range). command was:
```
./eval_embeddings.sh --model compact-embed-v2 --dims 384 --holdout news-100k --quant int8_pc --backend onnxruntime --batch 512
```

anya: results (holdout aggregated):
- fp32 baseline (embed-base-512 downsampled to 384): recall@1=0.741, recall@5=0.869, recall@10=0.892, silhouette=0.42
- compact-embed-v2 fp32: recall@1=0.732, recall@5=0.861, recall@10=0.884, silhouette=0.40
- compact-embed-v2 int8_pc: recall@1=0.705, recall@5=0.823, recall@10=0.779, silhouette=0.33
- id-flips (top-10 neighbors) between fp32 and int8: 12.4%

anya: attached the quick UMAP compare (small sample) and nearest-neighbor examples — clusters look compressed and some semantic neighbors lost. not dramatic at R1 but R10 drop is worrying.

miguel: thanks. first-pass thoughts: per-channel should usually be better than per-tensor, but for this architecture the activation range distribution is skewed. did you use percentile 99.9 for range clipping or max?

anya: used max range (no clipping). eval-bot: auto-run summary attached: job 67544 completed 18m ago, mem 42GB, runtime 14m.

miguel: try rerun with calibration using pct=99.5 and also try symmetric->asymmetric quantization for weights. small script change:
```python
quantize(model, backend='onnx', per_channel=True, clip_pct=99.5, asymmetric=True)
```

sasha: also toggle normalizer on embeddings (l2 vs noop) in the downstream recall pipeline; sometimes quant noise interacts with l2 causing NN reorder. run both with and without l2.

anya: will run two variants: (A) clip99.5 + asym per-channel, (B) clip99.5 + per-tensor symmetric, each with l2 on/off. expect 4 runs, queuing now. will post numbers when done. thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:

eval-bot: queued run ids: 67552, 67553, 67554, 67555. ETA ~45m.

sasha: if A recovers >90% of fp32 recall@10 then we can promote quant profile to default for compact-embed-v2. if not, may need to keep fp32 or try per-layer mixed precision.

anya: ack. will follow up in this thread with numbers and a few NN examples for manual sanity checks.
